name: j-cc
description: Harness tuning for Claude models in Claude Code: dedicated-tool routing, deterministic shell guards, background long-running commands. No external model or API key.

dedicatedTools.title: Route file work to dedicated tools
dedicatedTools.description: Block shell commands that only view, search, write or edit files (cat, grep, find, sed -i, heredocs, Set-Content, ...) and point Claude to Read, Grep, Glob, Write and Edit. Turn off to let the shell do file work; waits, endless loops and foreground Bash are still handled.

modelJudge.title: Model judge for ambiguous commands
modelJudge.description: Ask a small model inside Claude Code (no API key) whether a script or loop the rules cannot decide will wait, run endlessly, or take minutes.

blockChaining.title: Block command chaining
blockChaining.description: Block Bash, PowerShell and exec commands that chain with &&, || or ; outside quotes, so each command runs in its own call. Off by default: splitting harmless chains costs extra round trips.

timeAwareness.title: Tell the model the current time
timeAwareness.description: Add the current local time to each user message and, about once a minute, to a tool result in the main session, so the model can plan against deadlines like "in 15 minutes".

askAsync.title: Ask without stopping work
askAsync.description: Add the mcp__j-cc__ask_async tool: Claude shows a question above the prompt and keeps working; your next message is passed to it as the reply, and the question expires after the time Claude set. Off by default.
